name: awesome-ios-black-friday (thephux)
accepts: Indie apps for Apple platforms. The README (not CONTRIBUTING.md) says: 'Picked for this list: deals of 35% or more on iPhone and iPad apps, and 50% or more on Mac-only apps.' No SaaS, web apps, browser extensions, developer tools, courses, books, templates or boilerplates.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding one row per app at the end of the right category table in the README.
entry_format: | [App Name](App Store url) | iOS, macOS | One line on what it does. | 💸 ♾️ **50% OFF Lifetime** · $39.99 → $19.99 · code `BF26` | Nov 20 – Dec 1 |
rules: A clear discount: a percentage, or a before → after price. The deal must be live during the sale window, not a waitlist or a 'coming soon'.
One entry per app; several apps get one row each. No shortened, tracking or affiliate links.
The pull request template has six boxes, none of them a licence box.
Created 17 Nov 2026 with four commits by the owner. On 20 Nov 2026: five open pull requests, one withdrawn, none merged. Check whether pull requests get merged before counting on it.
status_note: No merge yet as of 20 Nov 2026; a maybe, not a yes.
